title: Instructions générales sur la manière de remplir la déclaration d'impôt des personnes physiques
why_needed: Official filing instructions for the 2025 return: deadlines, filing channels, source-tax and TOU rules.
notes: Form 21001, edition code 03.26 printed on the document. States ordinary deadline 15 March 2026 and tolerance to 30 June 2026.

title: Déclaration d'impôt 2025, personnes physiques (formule 21010)
why_needed: Main income and wealth return for natural persons, tax year 2025.
notes: Edition V2 07.25 (form code 0210_B 21010). No formal title printed on the form; the title here is descriptive. Both spouses or partners living together must sign.

title: Annexe 01, Déclaration d'impôt 2025, Rendements bruts échus en 2025
why_needed: Gross securities income and wealth at 31.12.2025, plus bank and postal accounts.
notes: Form code 0220_B 21014, edition V2 07.25.

title: Déclaration d'impôt 2025, Annexe 02 (formule 21018) et Annexe 03 (formule 21019)
why_needed: Debts and life insurance (annex 02); family situation and salary certificate summary (annex 03).
notes: Edition V2 07.25 CEd. Salary certificate summary sits on the 21019 pages.

title: Déclaration d'impôt 2025, Annexes 04 et 05 (formules 21024 et 22025)
why_needed: Professional expenses of salaried persons (including training), medical and disability costs, donations.
notes: Edition V2 07.25 CEd. Text extraction was jumbled, so the page-to-annex mapping is only partly confirmed; check the printed layout.

title: Annexe 07, Déclaration d'impôt 2025, immeubles
why_needed: Only needed if the household owns property: rental value, gross income, maintenance costs.
notes: Footer code 32 V2 07.25 CEd. Covers up to two properties.

title: Barème de l'impôt sur le revenu 2025
why_needed: Income tax scale for tax year 2025.
notes: Scale is stated at a 100 percent base; the cantonal coefficient is separate (see vd-2025-coefficient-cantonal). The extracted text did not restate the canton; identity taken from the ACI forms page.

title: Barème de l'impôt sur la fortune 2025
why_needed: Wealth tax scale for tax year 2025.
notes: Scale is stated at a 100 percent base; the cantonal coefficient is separate. The extracted text did not restate the canton.

title: Barème de l'impôt sur le revenu 2026
why_needed: Income tax scale for tax year 2026, for the next filing cycle.
notes: Title and year confirmed; the extracted text did not restate the canton. Scale stated at a 100 percent base.

title: Barème de l'impôt sur la fortune 2026
why_needed: Wealth tax scale for tax year 2026.
notes: Title and year confirmed; the extracted text did not restate the canton. Scale stated at a 100 percent base.

title: Coefficient cantonal
why_needed: Cantonal multiplier applied to the base income and wealth scales.
notes: HTML page, not a PDF. Lists values by year from 2009 to 2025. No 2026 value on the page at verification.

title: Finances communales
why_needed: Only official link found to communal tax rates by commune.
notes: Links the xlsx Taux d'imposition, dès 1990, par commune, Vaud (https://www.vd.ch/fileadmin/user_upload/organisation/dfin/statvd/Dom_22/Tableaux/T22.18_Taux-impot_depuis-1990.xlsx). That file opens but its contents could not be read, so the 2025 values are NOT verified.

title: Arrêtés d'imposition
publisher: Direction générale des affaires institutionnelles et des communes (DGAIC), Etat de Vaud
why_needed: Explains how communal coefficients are set, submitted and published.
notes: Communes submit arrêtés before 30 October; the department publishes them in the Feuille des avis officiels in August and November. Links a vd.ch table page that the fetch tool refused (robots rule).

title: Tableau des principales déductions vaudoises 2025
why_needed: Official overview of principal deductions and their caps for 2025.
notes: Covers commuting, meals, professional costs, health insurance, pension contributions, childcare, housing, medical costs, gifts, family deductions. Caps are listed; amounts are not copied here.

title: Barèmes et instructions concernant l'imposition à la source pour l'année 2026
why_needed: Source-tax scales (tarifs A, B, C, G, H, I-J-K, L-Q) and employer instructions for 2026.
notes: Reference 21.034-10 / 11.2025, dated Lausanne, December 2025. States TOU on request is due by 31 March and cannot be withdrawn. Extraction cut off in section 6.

title: Barèmes et instructions concernant l'imposition à la source pour l'année 2025
why_needed: Source-tax scales that applied to 2025 salaries, needed to check 2025 withholding.
notes: Reference 21.034-10 / 11.2024, dated Lausanne, March 2025.

title: Demande de taxation ordinaire ultérieure (TOU)
why_needed: Form to request ordinary taxation instead of source tax, with its deadline and irrevocability.
notes: Form 21049 TOU, not tied to one year. Request due by 31 March of the year after the fiscal year concerned; cannot be withdrawn once validly filed; both spouses sign if married or in a partnership.

title: Directive concernant l'imposition des travailleurs frontaliers domiciliés en France et exerçant une activité lucrative dépendante en Suisse auprès d'un employeur vaudois pour l'année 2025
why_needed: Source-tax rules for cross-border workers living in France (frontaliers).
notes: Reference 21.045, dated Lausanne, November 2025. Covers the French residence certificate (ARF) and the telework limit for frontalier status. Does not cover TOU options.

title: Demandes de délais unitaires (personnes physiques) : Directive
why_needed: Authoritative deadlines and extension rules for the 2025 return.
notes: Document titled Délais pour le dépôt de la déclaration d'impôt 2025. Ordinary deadline 15 March 2026; extension requests up to 30 June 2026; postal force-majeure requests until 30 September 2026 for a final extension to 31 October 2026.

title: Remplir ma déclaration d'impôt avec VaudTax
why_needed: States the approved software list for 2025, the paper and electronic filing rules, and the e-Délai link.
notes: General VaudTax page, not year-specific; the software list shown is for 2025. Approved programmes listed: Dr. Tax VD PP 2025 (v1.0), Windfisc 2025 (v.25D.A), KTax Vaud 2025 (v1.0-001). Read by the fetch tool; confirm on the page.

title: Remplir ma déclaration d'impôt 2025 avec la prestation VaudTax pour les individus (personnes physiques)
why_needed: 2025 VaudTax start page: access identifiers and the online filing portal.
notes: Filing portal https://prestations.vd.ch/pub/101660/ (24/7). Needs the taxpayer number and the control code from the A3 transmission form. No Vaud login or e-ID described.

title: Notice relative à l'établissement de la déclaration d'impôt et de la demande de modification d'acomptes à l'aide d'un outil informatique
why_needed: Rules for returns printed from commercial software, with barcode page and signature requirements.
notes: Edition 09.2015, so partly outdated. Says commercial-software printouts must be certified by the ACI. Cites the Règlement du 19 décembre 2011 (RDVE).

title: Impôts communaux 2025, arrêtés d'imposition (mis à jour après référendum)
publisher: Direction générale des affaires institutionnelles et des communes (DGAIC), Direction des finances communales, Vaud
why_needed: Communal tax rate of every Vaud commune for tax year 2025, in percent of the cantonal base tax.
notes: Excel 97 file, sheet arreteImposition, one row per commune grouped by district. Columns: impôt revenu, fortune, bénéfice, capital (1), impôt spécial affecté (2), pour-cent total (1+2), then property and transfer taxes. Footnote marks the update after the referendum vote of 18 May 2025. Linked as 'Impôts communaux 2025' from https://www.vd.ch/etat-droit-finances/communes/finances-communales/archives-des-1994

title: Taux d'impôt 2026, arrêtés d'imposition des communes vaudoises
publisher: Direction générale des affaires institutionnelles et des communes (DGAIC), Direction des finances communales, Vaud
why_needed: Communal tax rate of every Vaud commune for tax year 2026, in percent of the cantonal base tax.
notes: Same layout as the 2025 file; file last saved 15 December 2025. Footnote ** marks arrêtés extended by law (art. 35 LICom). Linked as 'taux d'impôt 2026' from https://www.vd.ch/etat-droit-finances/communes/finances-communales/arretes-dimposition-et-tableaux-des-impots-communaux. Can change after communal referendums: rerun the fetch script with --check before relying on it

title: Tableau des principales déductions vaudoises 2026
